name: com.jobsfrontrunner/jobs
title: Frontrunner Jobs
description: Search open jobs from employers' own career pages in the US, Canada, India and remote. No sign-in.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs on Frontrunner by what the person wants, in plain words: role, skills, place, remote or on-site, seniority, pay, company, how recent. Covers the US, Canada, India, Europe and remote roles, read from employers' own career pages. Returns up to 24 jobs a page with title, company, place, salary when known, posted date and a link to each job on Frontrunner. Use it whenever someone asks to find, list or compare job openings.

query.description: What the person is looking for, in their own words: role, skills, seniority, place, pay, company, how recent. Any language. Examples: "senior data engineer in Hyderabad, 40 lpa", "remote product designer jobs in Europe", "jobs at Stripe", "entry level nursing jobs Toronto". Leave empty to list the newest jobs.

work_mode.description: Where the work happens. Any of: remote (Remote), hybrid (Hybrid), onsite (On-site).

seniority.description: Experience level. Any of: entry (Entry level), mid (Mid level), senior (Senior), lead (Lead & exec), manager (Manager), director (Director).

employment_type.description: Contract type. Any of: full-time (Full-time), part-time (Part-time), contract (Contract), internship (Internship).

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. Rounded up to one of 1, 7, 14, 30.

min_salary.description: Lowest acceptable pay, written the way people say it: "40 lpa", "$150k", "€70k", "3000 per month".

sort.description: relevance (best match, the default when there is a query), new (newest first) or pay (highest paying first).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one job on Frontrunner in full: the written description, skills, years of experience, salary when known, whether it is still open, common questions, and the links to view and apply. Pass the url (or slug) that search_jobs returned.

job.description: The job's Frontrunner URL (https://jobsfrontrunner.com/jobs/...) or its slug, exactly as search_jobs returned it.
